summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for new public exposure, go-live, affiliate/advertising expansion, and rights-dependent data use; CONDITIONAL for ordinary reversible growth that adds no new collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, unsupported claims, or public exposure. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private; do not send rights outreach or approve a public beta. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not redistribution rights; current Woot terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, and derivative use. Compliance is technical only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Revenue evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. For private/gated sites, keep complicated.work preview-only with no publish, and keep deadlymaracas.com unlaunched pending reachability and compliance evidence. No go-live proposal is supported.

SearchWoot launch-readiness progress: 0 of 4 open legal tasks closed. Existing evidence is partial: source-rights evidence confirms official API documentation and restrictive public terms; data-flow evidence exists in backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, and config.yml but lacks operator-confirmed retention, deletion, correction, access, and notification records; privacy and cookie pages exist but GA4 property/data-sharing settings and jurisdiction-specific review are missing; terms are draft-only and do not establish upstream permission. Keep tracking active. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only evidence bundle covering the four open tasks without changing production or sending outreach.

Data-use review decisions: Woot deal and price-history data is BLOCKED pending a current API agreement or written permission, field-level provenance, permitted storage/cache/display/alerts, attribution and freshness rules, correction/takedown process, and human-counsel review; smallest action is to assemble the authoritative terms and permission record, with outreach remaining unsent. User alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest action is a repository/configuration data-flow table. GA4 is EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention configuration, and jurisdictional review; smallest action is a read-only consent/configuration capture. Operational logs and Cloudflare data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures; smallest action is a read-only vendor/log/incident inventory. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, privacy/jurisdiction treatment, and any future affiliate, advertising, alert, or public-display use.
